title: Irregular verbs: the site's list, group by group

blocks.text: The irregular verbs of the site's own list (the Grammar tab, **Irregular Verbs**): the verbs whose forms cannot be guessed from the infinitive, in the same groups, with practice on each.

head: group in the list
verbs
rows: **-ять and -чать: a hidden м or н**
**-ить verbs that change in the я-form only**
blocks.caption: 107 verbs in 9 groups

items: Each lesson here is one group of the list, with the forms exactly as the list gives them, then practice with the verbs of that group and no others.
Many of these verbs also belong to one of the sixteen types: the lessons on the types teach the pattern, these lessons teach the verbs that need to be known by heart.
